observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a metallic engine block with visible wear, dirt, and some green paint residue. A label with 'TOYOTA' and part numbers is visible on the side.

Photo 1 and Photo 2 show multiple engines stacked together in what appears to be a workshop or storage area. The engines have black plastic covers over the cylinder heads, with various hoses, belts, and components visible.
The engines in photos 1 and 2 appear to be of similar design, with black intake manifolds and some red markings on the plastic covers.
The watermark 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' is present on all photos, suggesting the seller's name or business.
No visible damage to the engine blocks or cylinders in the photos, but the condition is mixed with dirt and grime.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a label with 'TOYOTA' and part number '2GR', but no full engine is shown. The claim of 'complete' cannot be verified from the photos alone.
No proof of origin is visible in the photos. The watermark 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' suggests a seller based in New Zealand, not Belgium.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional despite appearance
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to check for cracks or wear.

risks.risk: Engine may be missing critical components (e.g., ECU, sensors, wiring harness)
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video showing all parts included, including the ECU, sensors, and wiring harness.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number with the vehicle's registration details.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown origin, which may reduce value

proof_requests: A full 360-degree photo or video of the engine showing all components included.
A video of the engine running or a close-up of the internal components to verify condition.
A photo of the engine's serial number and any vehicle registration details to verify origin.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
